drums.tags: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences. A distorted, overdriven kick drum provides a constant four-on-the-floor pulse at 130 BPM in the key of D minor. A resonant, metallic synth bassline follows a syncopated sixteenth-note pattern with high-pass filter automation. Industrial percussion layers include a gated white noise snare on beats 2 and 4, accompanied by harsh, metallic hi-hats and claps with short decay. A dark, detuned saw-wave lead synth enters with a repetitive, dissonant three-note motif. Periodic industrial sound effects, such as mechanical clangs and distorted vocal-like textures, are processed with heavy bit-crushing and short room reverb. The arrangement features sudden low-pass filter sweeps and rhythmic stutter effects on the master bus.

[Outro]
[kick drum returns, rhythmic stutter effect]
[instruments fade out, leaving distorted kick tail]

bass.tags: Hard rock drum stem. The performance features a standard four-piece kit with a crisp, dry snare and a punchy kick drum. The hi-hats are played slightly open for a washier texture during more intense sections. The drummer utilizes frequent crash cymbal accents and occasional ride cymbal bell hits. The pattern is characterized by a steady backbeat with syncopated kick drum variations and rapid sixteenth-note snare fills. The recording has a natural room resonance with minimal artificial reverb. 120 BPM. 4/4 time signature.
